messages:
liz (AE): Heads-up — AtlasHealth POC kicks off Mon. They asked for a concise preflight: auth, SDK examples, quotas, streaming/retries, security questionnaire status, and a rough pricing ballpark. Can @marco or @jenny confirm what we should send?

marco (SE): I can take tech/integration. Quick checklist draft: 1) API key vs OAuth for service account 2) SDK snippets (node/python) 3) streaming vs non-streaming use cases 4) expected QPS and token volumes 5) retry/idempotency guidance 6) example prometheus metrics & headers for rate limits.

jenny (Sales Eng): I'll cover security/compliance + success criteria. Quick notes: we need customer's network posture (VPC peering or NAT), KMS/HSM for key envelope, SSO/SAML for team access. Also ask them to share their security questionnaire PDF so we can prefill answers.

sam (AtlasHealth): Thanks — a few specifics from our side: we'll run on a prod-sim dataset (PHI masked) in a VPC, prefer KMS integration, and need SAML for dev access. Target throughput is ~10 r/s with burst to 50 for short periods. Expected tokens ~600k/day during tests. Also want streaming for partial responses in UI.

marco (SE): Great — for auth options: if they want short-lived creds + rotation, OAuth2 with service account or our client-managed KMS flow works. For quick POC we usually give a scoped API key tied to the POC project and rotate daily. Example node SDK snippet (streaming):

```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-large-v1', messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'Summarize...'}] });
for await (const chunk of stream) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta); }
```

curl non-streaming example (token limits + headers):

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","input":"..."}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

marco (SE): Retry guidance: use exponential backoff with jitter, max 3 retries for 5xx/429. For idempotency on mutating ops, include an idempotency token header: `Idempotency-Key`. Rate-limit headers we return: `x-rw-rate-limit-limit`, `x-rw-rate-limit-remaining`, `x-rw-rate-limit-reset`. Default per-key quota for hosted POC is 100 r/s and 1M tokens/day unless we set a custom quota.

jenny (Sales Eng): Success criteria suggestion (align with customer): - Functional: model integrates with their UI and returns responses for top-10 use cases with >=95% availability during tests. - Quality: on a seed eval set of 250 prompts, error/hallucination rate <= 2% (we can run eval harness). - Perf: p95 latency for typical prompts (<256 tokens) <= 300ms in hosted region. - Observability: telemetry & cost per-token numbers available in Console.

sam (AtlasHealth): Can you confirm billing estimate for a 2-week POC with ~8M tokens total? Also need to know if streaming affects pricing.

jenny (Sales Eng): Quick estimate: hosted pricing band for redwood-large-v1 is ~$0.0018 per token-gen (example). Streaming doesn't change per-token charges (still billed by tokens), but causes more small network ops — negligible cost delta. I'll follow up with exact quote in an email after we finalize expected token counts.

marco (SE): Integration runbook I can send — minimal steps: 1) create POC project + API key 2) whitelist AtlasHealth CIDRs / add VPC config 3) SDK install + run sample 4) smoke test (10 requests, modal checks) 5) run batch eval (1000 prompts) 6) load test (10 r/s -> 50 r/s burst). Add note: enable prefix KV caching for conversational flows to lower token usage.

liz (AE): Timeline proposed: week 0 (prep) — share SQ & get KMS/SAML requirements; week 1 — integration + smoke tests; week 2 — load & eval + success criteria sign-off. Can we commit to that?

marco (SE): Yes. I'll attach a short ZIP with SDK snippets and a `postman` collection. Also include a small eval harness (python script) that uploads the 250 prompt set and computes pass/fail. Sample eval command (python):

```bash
python eval_harness.py --model redwood-large-v1 --input prompts.csv --metric exact_match --out results.json
```

deploy-bot: staging model redwood-large-v1-2026-03-18 deployed to region us-east-1 :rocket:

sam (AtlasHealth): Perfect — I'll send over our security questionnaire and a CSV with 300 golden prompts (PHI masked). Also confirm: can we use a tokenized test dataset with TTL so data is removed after POC?

jenny (Sales Eng): Yes — we can configure data retention for the POC project (30-day TTL or wipe at end). We'll document retention in the SQ reply.

liz (AE): Action items: @marco attach SDK + runbook + eval harness by EOD Fri; @jenny prepare SQ answers + provisional quote; @sam send SQ + prompt CSV. I'll coordinate kickoff calendar invite. :thumbsup:

marco (SE): On it.

jenny (Sales Eng): Will do.

sam (AtlasHealth): Sending docs now. Thanks everyone!
